The immutable Hub package is the public Hub SDK and CLI packed (`npm pack`) from AgentOrg `d44bfc7dfa103fc4da00ffd50b36f094551ed407`: the head of the Hub's stack adopting the Workspace ahead of its first release, [AgentOrg PRs 68–72](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/72), before it merges. The authoritative Tool descriptions are used without a local override.

`agentorg-cli-d44bfc7.tgz` has SHA256 `7d3dd19740cf90396c324cb3f813433ff456b7e2804f9507b9d0baad352b50da`. Production imports only its public `@agentorg/cli/contract` schemas/types. Tests additionally launch its public `agentorg-server` command against an owned temporary home and use exported Actor APIs. No sibling checkout or private server/storage imports are used.

The Hub bundles `@uniac/agentic-workspace` ahead of its first release, at source `6c8c0a6`: asks on Work, routed to the asker's manager and raised one manager up, answered with `work_answer`; approvals answered only by the asker's managers; submissions answered by their requester; and Messages in their pair's conversation. The full Hub catalog has 8 Tools and 21 interfaces, each tagged with its level; 8 are at the Report level. Test fixtures always use new empty homes.
